text:
kira: Quick sync - we need a non-scary Console flow for v1 deprecation. Key asks: what Console shows, probe mechanics, and invoice expectations.

Tom: My 2¢: show 3 steady states: Info (preview), Probe (live samples), Enforce (switch). Keep copy calm. No red until Enforce. :white_check_mark: 

lydia: For Probe, prefer shadow by default + tiny live cohort opt-in. Provide a simulate button that runs the estimator and a short sample of anonymized mismatches.

ops-jen: Telemetry: emit `compat_phase`, `probe_id`, `routed_model`, `route_reason`. Also add `probe_hdr: X-Compat-Probe` for opt-in.

billing-bot: Billing note: invoicing uses the model that actually executed. Console can call `estimate_delta(project, candidate)` to show a pre-enforce estimate. We'll return tokenization factor if needed.

kira: Good. Also need an escape hatch: automatic rollback if 5xx spike or customer reports. Default thresholds: 3x 5xx or >0.5% absolute increase. Ops must be able to flip toggle.

Tom: Implementation checklist: 1) routing emits billing_model_id on execution; 2) probe header respected; 3) UI mock + copy; 4) sampled raw mismatch dumps (PII scrubbed) for ML (retain 14 days).

lydia: UX copy sketch: "Compatibility: PARTIAL — requests may be routed to compatible variants. Billing reflects the model that served your request. Run a probe to estimate impact." Short and clear.

ops-jen: I'll add runbook entries and scrub rules. We should schedule a staging probe next week.

kira: Thanks — owners: Tom (routing), Lydia (Console), Ops-Jen (telemetry/runbook), Billing-Bot (estimator). I'll file a PR and link mocks here. :thumbsup:
